title: OA-MPPI: Occlusion-Aware Model Predictive Path Integral Control for UAV Flight
description:
arXiv:2609.28709v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous UAV flight through cluttered and partially unknown environments requires reasoning not only about observed obstacles but also about occluded regions that the sensor cannot observe. We present OA-MPPI, an obstacle- and occlusion-aware extension of Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control for quadrotor flight that accounts for potential moving agents emerging from these regions into the vehicle's path.
